name: Just-In-Time Activation - 15 Minute Reminder for Requested-For Identity
description: Notifies a manager, owner, or other interested party that a Just-In-Time activation initiated by another identity expires in 15 minutes.
subject: Just-In-Time access for ${requestedForIdentityName} expires in 15 minutes
body:
Just-In-Time Activation Reminder

Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time access window that ${requestedForIdentityName} initiated for ${entitlementName} will expire in 15 minutes.

#if($applicationName)

Application: $applicationName

#end

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
